_doc: Machine-readable driver script for the live E2E suite. Prose spec: e2e/PLAN.md. openclaw executes `steps` in order; monitor.py scores `expect_sequence` against data/queue.json.

step_actions.create_issue: POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues with `title` + `body` (implicit step 0 of every scenario)
step_actions.api_put_file: PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/{path} on `branch` with `content` (openclaw acting as a plain committer, not autoSWE)
step_actions.await_label: poll issue labels until `autoswe:<value>` is present, or `timeout_s` elapses (-> verdict stalled)
step_actions.await_ci: poll GET /repos/{o}/{r}/commits/{sha}/status until `state` == the given value
step_actions.await_no_change: assert the autoswe:* label does not change for `polls` consecutive poller ticks
step_actions.await_label_chain: poll until the labels listed appear in order, with no comment posted in between (used for auto re-review)
